title: GEO Lab #04: Historical creator selection, independent new samples and source audit

prompts.Q1: What are the best free resources to learn Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) in 2026? Include sources when available.
prompts.Q2: What credible experiments have measured whether GEO tactics increase AI brand mentions or recommendations? Include sources when available.
prompts.Q3: Who publishes practical, data-backed GEO tutorials for independent builders? Explain why and include sources when available.

design.unit: One stateless API request or one new private Grok conversation; exactly one original prompt, no follow-ups.
design.order_policy: Three repeat blocks; question and environment order shuffled. Actual order and deviations retained; any pending condition may be bypassed without changing a prompt.

openai_api.search: Native web_search; tool_choice required; live access; actual tool calls stored separately from citations.
openai_api.context: Exactly one original user prompt. No system/developer steering, history, previous_response_id, conversation ID, account identifiers or candidate names.
openai_api.backend_snapshot: Undated returned model identifier; underlying snapshot not independently verified.

grok.backend_model: Not exposed unless UI provides it
grok.search: Native retrieval; record actual controls, search queries and executed retrieval separately. No textual search instructions appended.
grok.personalization: X and conversation-history personalization disabled during collection; restoration completion is documented separately. Original preference values are omitted.
grok.preflight_status: Expert and private chats verified; both experiment personalization switches OFF. Original account preference values omitted.

authorization.extra_submissions: Not authorized for this new stage; stop and ask if replacements beyond nine requests per environment are needed.
authorization.publication: Redacted public edition authorized on 2026-11-03; private originals and account UI remain local.

publication_amendments.scope: User authorized redacted Stage 4 raw data and revised reports to the existing public GitHub repository and GitHub Pages. No new social post authorized.
publication_amendments.historical_note: The original publication field describes the earlier collection checkpoint; this dated amendment supersedes its local-only scope without changing the registered collection design.

selection.uses: Frozen Stage1 observations, not new samples
selection.limitation: Historical selection is not independent proof of future visibility. Stage4 API differs from Stage1 consumer ChatGPT Search. Aleyda cross-platform counts come from different questions.

candidates.historical_identity_note: Q1 names the resource brand The GEO Lab without naming Artur; Q3 R1 explicitly names both.

coding.unit: Candidate family × selected complete answer; retain exact text/name/URL evidence and separate person from associated assets.
coding.person_mention: Personal name explicitly appears in answer body; not inferred from a domain or asset.
coding.asset_mention: A predeclared or subsequently verified associated content asset explicitly appears in body; record exact name separately.
coding.citation: Observable answer-body citation links to confirmed own/bylined content. Third-party coverage is separate; retrieval-only sources and whole-panel anchors are not citations. Unknown attribution is null, not assumed.
coding.recommendation: Active suggestion to read/use/follow, or selected answer to the prompt; incidental, criticized or excluded mentions do not qualify. Person-level and asset-level recommendation targets retained.
coding.family_rollup: Transparent union across confirmed personal/asset observations, never relabeled as explicit person mention.
coding.retrieval: Separate evidence for searched/fetched sources, not automatically C/M/R.
coding.method: Assistant observational reading with quoted evidence; no independent human double coding claimed.
coding.denominators: Per question × environment n=3, plus clearly labeled all-question pooled n=9; no stable probabilities inferred.

source_audit.order: After new sample collection, prioritize Artur, then Aleyda, then Kevin.
source_audit.selection: 2–3 distinct actual body-cited own/bylined content pages per creator, prioritized by recurrence then direct fit to prompt. Retain selection rationale.
source_audit.shortfall_policy: If fewer than two eligible pages appear, report the shortfall. Do not substitute uncited pages as holdout citations. Optional linked context pages must be explicitly separate from the cited-page sample.
dimensions: Low-cost reusable practices versus reputation/audience/data advantages
source_audit.limitations: Purposive descriptive audit, not proof of why AI recommends an author or a general content-quality ranking. Access failures and unsupported claims retained.

requirements: Full coherent answer body independently read
Body URLs distinguished from retrieval/source-panel URLs

limits: 18 answers provide short-term observations, not long-term stability.
Historical ChatGPT UI and current OpenAI API are different conditions; no pure longitudinal consumer-platform comparison.
No intervention or causal mechanism identification.
Existing reputations, audiences and commercial resources are background advantages, not directly replicable strategies.

api_collection.budget_policy: US$10 authorized total; sequential admission with US$6.60 reservation, usage-priced estimates, stop on unknown outcomes. No automatic budget increase. Estimates require provider-billing reconciliation.

execution_notes: API Q2 R1 submitted before Grok Q2 R1 while Grok preflight/settings were being verified; planned order retained and actual timestamps authoritative.
Grok Expert exposes native retrieval but no independent force-search toggle was observed. Actual search must be evidenced per answer, with no appended search instruction.

capture_incidents.summary: One reusable browser capture helper initially retained a previous record binding. The mismatched capture was preserved, the prior Q3 selected record restored from the already saved attempts snapshot, and Q1 re-read against its matching visible user prompt. Subsequent helpers take an explicit record and verify the visible prompt.
capture_incidents.effect_on_selected_body: No wrong answer selected; restored original full Q3 text/URLs retained. The initial Q3 DOM HTML file was not retained; its expanded native search snapshot and raw record remain.

remaining_gaps: No independent human double coding or underlying-source dataset replication.
Grok exact backend snapshot and an independently forced search toggle are not exposed; native retrieval was observed in all nine answers.

public_edition.authorization: User authorized redacted Stage 4 data/report publication to the existing public GitHub repository and GitHub Pages.
public_edition.condition_notice: OpenAI Responses API + native web search, not consumer ChatGPT Search. These results do not represent ChatGPT web app performance.
public_edition.historical_scope: Earlier local-only authorization text belongs to the original collection checkpoint; the dated public-release authorization supersedes it. Redacted registration copies are not byte-identical to private originals.
